title: Count Frequency Staircase Subarrays I
statement: The task is to count 'frequency staircase' subarrays, whose distinct values, ordered by first appearance, occur exactly 1, 2, ..., k times. With n up to 1500, an O(n^2) brute-force scan passes: fix the left end, extend right, store each value's first-appearance rank and count in a hash map, and track how many values' counts differ from their rank; a subarray qualifies when none do.
